reviews.title: Great monitor for the price, poor instructions
reviews.comment:
This review is for the Arctic Pro 27" AD27EQBR.
The only thing I could dock this for would be poor instructions and I'm not going to do that, as it would be unfair. This monitor totally up's my gaming. Does it lack some features other monitors have? Yes. Is it a monster for its price tag? Yes.
I was having trouble navigating the menu. I could not turn off the reading lamp. When I would try to exit the menu, it would turn back on. This and some of the other menu items would switch right back. I accidently found out what I was doing wrong. I was changing a setting and backing out and it would revert back. The TRICK is instead of thumbing back to the left (like entering a doorway and then backing out of the same doorway), Push the joystick on the back of the panel to the right! So simple. I was ready to return this item just because the instructions do not tell you to do this. Still giving 5 stars.
It irks me that we cannot make monitors this well for this PRICE in the U.S.
reviews.author: Keith Lillie

reviews.title: An Epic Ode to Gaming Glory
reviews.comment:
Behold the monitor—no mere machine,
But a portal forged in obsidian sheen.
Its resolution, 1440p divine,
Where clarity and carnage intertwine.
Helldivers descend in pixel-born flame,
Each frame a vow, each death a name.
The screen does not blink, does not forgive—
It renders the cost of the will to live.
IPS-born, with colors true,
It paints each dive in spectral hue.
FreeSync binds the chaos tight,
No tear shall mar the sacred fight.
Response time? A blink, a breath—
1ms defying death.
This is no screen. It is decree—
A lens through which the brave break free.
reviews.author: Timm Hart
